test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The brave knight set out to __vanquish__ the fearsome dragon and protect the kingdom from its menace.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vanquish"** means **to defeat thoroughly or conquer completely.** (पराजित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The army managed to** vanquish** their enemies in the decisive battle.
 
 
 
• **"Liberate"** refers to **setting someone free from a situation, especially imprisonment or oppression.** (मुक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The rebels aimed to **liberate **the prisoners from the oppressive regime.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'vanquish' **is **'liberate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Measure **(मापना): To ascertain the size, amount, or degree of something.

 
 
• **Example:** We need to **measure** the dimensions of the room before buying furniture.
 
 
 
• **Engage **(संपर्क करना): To participate or become involved in.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher tried to **engage** the students in a discussion about the topic.
 
 
 
• **Instill **(बिठाना): To gradually but firmly establish an idea or attitude into a person's mind.
 
 
• **Example:** Parents should** instill** good values in their children from a young age.
